Welcome
Welcome to Beehive, an independent ISA Prep School for children aged 2.5 to 11.
Beehive has been an independent school since 1926 and offers a first rate Prep School experience for all students.
Since its opening, Beehive has long had a tradition of offering excellent pastoral care whilst ensuring that academic standards are kept high. Its small family size means that every child has a voice and as such is given the opportunity to flourish in the school environment. Why not contact us and come and see for yourself.
Mission Statement.
Beehive Prep School exists to prepare children for success in learning, work and life.
When our children leave Beehive, they will be:
literate, numerate and articulate
21st century, global citizens
fit and healthy - in body and mind
emotionally intelligent and resilient
the very best they can be
When our children leave Beehive, they will have:
an appreciation of culture, in its widest sense
a concept of who they are, where they come from and their place in the world
an understanding of our country, its values and what it means to be British
the tools necessary to thrive in the next stage of their education
a pride in what makes them unique
The whole school community will share our values:

Extra-Curricular Clubs
Current After School Clubs 2026-2027 include:
Lego, Sports Club, Performing Arts, Cricket, Friday Afternoon School, Homework, Breakfast & Teatime Club.
Breakfast Club (8am – 8.35am) Your child is supervised whilst eating their breakfast which they bring into school with them.
Homework Club (3pm-4pm) & Tea-time club run daily and offer your child the chance to complete their homework in a quiet environment. Your child may ask for help and we can check their completed work. It is not private tuition.
Clubs are invoiced termly.
We also offer LAMDA classes.

Learning Support
At Beehive Prep School, we recognise that children learn in different ways and at different levels.
We are not a selective prep school, so we take very seriously our responsibility of ensuring that all children reach their potential.
We acknowledge that for some children to do this, additional or different provision needs to be provided.
Additional Learning Support is not included in the basic tuition fee, however, by arrangement it is possible for parents to fund their children to have:
If a parent has any concerns about their child, in the first instance we encourage parents to discuss with their Class Teacher. Alternatively, an appointment can be requested with Miss Richards, the school’s Learning Support Co-Ordinator.
access to specialist assessments
One-to-One specialist teacher support
small group support in the class room
small group intervention support
EHC Plans
At Beehive Prep School we do not have the provision to accept new children under an EHC plan.
We are reviewing this currently (Jan 2026) and will keep you updated. For any further information, please contact the Headteacher.
